definitions.explanation: A rope made of rice straw, used in Shinto to mark sacred or purified areas. Often hung at shrine entrances or around sacred trees and rocks.

examples.japanese: ⟦{神社|じんじゃ}→神社：01620_jinja⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{鳥居|とりい}→鳥居：05956_torii⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{注連縄|しめなわ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{掛|か}かっている→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧。
examples.english: A shimenawa hangs on the shrine's torii gate.

examples.japanese: ⟦{正月|しょうがつ}→正月：01433_shougatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{玄関|げんかん}→玄関：05003_genkan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{注連縄|しめなわ}⟦{飾|かざ}り→飾り：02539_kazari⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{付|つ}ける→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧。
examples.english: We put up shimenawa decorations at the entrance for New Year.

examples.japanese: ⟦{御神木|ごしんぼく}→御神木：28521_goshinboku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{太|ふと}い→太い：02955_futoi⟧{注連縄|しめなわ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{巻|ま}かれている→巻く：02418_maku⟧。
examples.english: A thick shimenawa is wrapped around the sacred tree.

notes:
{注連縄|しめなわ} is a key element of Shinto ritual objects.

CHARACTERISTICS:
- Made from rice straw (⟦{藁|わら}→わら：27567_wara⟧)
- Often has white paper streamers (⟦{紙垂|しで}→紙垂：28322_shide⟧) attached
- Marks the boundary between sacred and profane space

FAMOUS EXAMPLES:
- ⟦{出雲大社|いずもたいしゃ}→出雲大社：29110_izumotaisha⟧ has one of Japan's largest {注連縄|しめなわ}

NEW YEAR CUSTOM:
{注連縄|しめなわ}⟦{飾|かざ}り→飾り：02539_kazari⟧ (shimenawa decoration) is displayed at entrances during the New Year period to invite good fortune.
